# Curves editor (`curves-editor`)

Tone curve with draggable points over a histogram.

Group: Charts & instruments. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/charts';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createButton` (types in `dist/web/actions/button.d.ts`): `.mh-button` with `--primary | --secondary | --tonal | --text | --danger` and `--sm | --lg`; states `.is-loading` and `:disabled`. Height follows the theme's density, corners its control radius.

```ts
export function createButton(options: ButtonOptions): ButtonHandle;

export interface ButtonOptions {
  label: string;
  variant?: ButtonVariant;
  size?: ButtonSize;
  icon?: IconName | string;
  trailingIcon?: IconName | string;
  loading?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  fullWidth?: boolean;
  type?: 'button' | 'submit' | 'reset';
  onClick?: (event: MouseEvent) => void;
}

export interface ButtonHandle {
  el: HTMLButtonElement;
  setLabel(label: string): void;
  setLoading(loading: boolean): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

`createCurvesEditor` (types in `dist/web/charts/curvesEditor.d.ts`): `.mh-curves`: a tone-curve editor. Drag a point to move it, press on an empty spot to add one and drag it, double-click a point (or press Delete) to remove it; the end points stay. The curve is a monotone cubic spline through the points (no overshoot), drawn over an optional histogram, with the identity diagonal for reference. Use `curveLut` to apply it. The web handle keeps its own points and reports changes.

```ts
export function createCurvesEditor(options: CurvesEditorOptions): CurvesEditorHandle;

export interface CurvesEditorOptions {
  /** Control points, sorted by input; at least two. */
  points: readonly CurvePoint[];
  /** The accessible name ("Tone curve"). */
  label: string;
  /** Bin counts drawn behind the curve, darkest first. */
  histogram?: readonly number[];
  /** Which channel the curve is for; sets its colour (default luminance, in the accent). */
  channel?: HistogramChannel;
  /** Called with the new points while dragging and after key presses. */
  onChange?: (points: CurvePoint[]) => void;
  /** Most points allowed (default 16). */
  maxPoints?: number;
  /** Arrow-key step (default 1/255); Shift moves ten steps. */
  step?: number;
  /** Formats a 0–1 level for screen readers; default 0–255. */
  format?: (level: number) => string;
  size?: ChartSize;
  disabled?: boolean;
}

export interface CurvesEditorHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  getPoints(): CurvePoint[];
  setPoints(points: readonly CurvePoint[]): void;
  setHistogram(histogram: readonly number[] | undefined): void;
  update(options: CurvesEditorOptions): void;
  destroy(): void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import {
  createButton,
  createCurvesEditor,
  createText,
  curveLut,
  type CurvePoint,
} from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const start: CurvePoint[] = [
  { x: 0, y: 0 },
  { x: 0.25, y: 0.2 },
  { x: 0.75, y: 0.82 },
  { x: 1, y: 1 },
];

const readout = createText('', { variant: 'caption', tone: 'muted' });
const show = (points: readonly CurvePoint[]): void => {
  const midtones = curveLut(points, 3)[1] ?? 0.5;
  readout.textContent = `${points.length} points · midtones ${Math.round(midtones * 255)}`;
};

const curves = createCurvesEditor({ points: start, label: 'Tone curve', onChange: show });
show(start);

const reset = createButton({
  label: 'Reset',
  variant: 'secondary',
  size: 'small',
  onClick: () => {
    curves.setPoints(start);
    show(start);
  },
});

document.body.append(curves.el, readout, reset.el);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Button, CurvesEditor, Text } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';
import { curveLut, type CurvePoint } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const start: CurvePoint[] = [
  { x: 0, y: 0 },
  { x: 0.25, y: 0.2 },
  { x: 0.75, y: 0.82 },
  { x: 1, y: 1 },
];

export function CurvesEditorExample() {
  const [points, setPoints] = useState(start);
  const midtones = curveLut(points, 3)[1] ?? 0.5;
  return (
    <>
      <CurvesEditor points={points} label="Tone curve" onChange={setPoints} />
      <Text variant="caption" tone="muted">
        {points.length} points · midtones {Math.round(midtones * 255)}
      </Text>
      <Button variant="secondary" size="small" onClick={() => setPoints(start)}>
        Reset
      </Button>
    </>
  );
}
```
